ERR_I2C_BAD_ARG.message: An I2C request is not valid

ERR_I2C_BAD_BUS.message: {bus} does not exist or is off
ERR_I2C_BAD_BUS.hint: Choose a bus the board has.

ERR_I2C_BAD_DEV_CFG.message: {addr} on {bus} is not a valid device setting

ERR_I2C_BUS_INIT.message: {bus} could not start on pins {sda} (SDA) and {scl} (SCL)

ERR_I2C_BUS_STUCK.message: {bus} is stuck while reaching {addr}: check the wiring and pull-ups
ERR_I2C_BUS_STUCK.hint: Check the wiring and the pull-up resistors, then restart the board.

ERR_I2C_DEV_NOT_FOUND.hint: Check that the module is connected and powered, and that its address is right.

ERR_I2C_DEV_NOT_ADDED.message: {addr} on {bus} is used before it is added

ERR_I2C_NO_ACK.hint: Check the wiring and the power of the module.

ERR_I2C_BUS_BUSY.hint: Try again; if it repeats, check the wiring of the bus.

ERR_I2C_XFER.hint: Check the wiring and the power of the module.

ERR_I2C_ADDR_TAKEN.message: {addr} on {bus} is already used by another device
ERR_I2C_ADDR_TAKEN.hint: Two devices cannot share an address: change one of them (its address pins or setting).

ERR_I2C_REMOTE_DENIED.message: {bus} cannot be used from the app
ERR_I2C_REMOTE_DENIED.hint: Use the bus the app may reach (the external I2C).
